where_to_go: Work Orders → open any work order
what_to_do: Look at the line prices, the Total/Labor/Parts columns, the Finance card, and the Stats tab.
expected_result: All prices and money are visible everywhere. Admin has See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec: a role with 'See Financial Data' ON (which Admin has) must see all money everywhere — line prices, the Total/Labor/Parts columns, the Finance card, and the Stats tab. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Administrator row #1 'See Financial ON']
expected_plain: Logged in as an Administrator, every price and dollar figure on a work order should be visible (nothing hidden or blanked out).
actual_result_plain: Opened work order S9-24674 as Admin. All money was visible: the Financial Info card showed Parts $0.00, Labor $150.00, Shop Supplies $15.75, Subtotal $165.75, GST $8.29, Total $174.04, Balance $0.00. The line grid showed Rate/Margin/Total columns with values. The Stats tab showed Sell price/Cost/Margin/% dollar figures. The Finance tab showed the full invoice/estimate with amounts plus Create Invoice/Add Deposit controls. Nothing was hidden.
notes: Reconfirmed later on AR Aging report and other WOs — financial data consistently visible for Admin.

where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order → header
what_to_do: Change mileage, engine hours, lead technician, service advisor, customer, and asset.
expected_result: All edits are allowed and save successfully. Admin has Work Orders Create and Edit.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec: Admin has Work Orders Create and Edit, so all work-order header edits are allowed and must save. NOTE row is STALE per v33: mileage/engine hours/license plate/VIN moved to WORK ORDER LINES: Create and Edit; header fields (customer/asset/service advisor/lead tech/status) remain Work Orders Create and Edit. Admin holds both. [Ref: SV-5319; checklist Administrator row #2 (marked STALE); superseded by row N1]
expected_plain: As an Administrator you should be able to change the work order's mileage, engine hours, service advisor, customer, asset and (via line-tech assignment) lead technician, and each change should save.
actual_result_plain: On a throwaway work order (S9-24716) all edits worked and persisted after reload: Mileage set to 12,345, Engine Hours to 678, License Plate to ZZTEST1 (all persisted). Service Advisor changed to 'Alexander Cohen' and persisted. The Change Customer and Change Asset pickers both opened and were functional (cancelled to preserve the throwaway identity). Work-order-level status is system-derived in this build (no direct dropdown) and lead technician is a read-only field populated by assigning a line technician — both are build behaviors, not permission blocks.
notes: STALE per spec v33 (still run). Mileage/engine hours/license plate now behave as line-level fields (WOL C&E) — see N1. Lead technician is derived from line-tech assignment; WO status auto-derives (Estimate→Reviewed→Complete→Invoiced). Neither is a permission failure for Admin.

where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order → a line
what_to_do: Delete a line; change a line's status (approve/decline/complete).
expected_result: Both allowed. Admin has Work Order Lines View/Create and Edit/Delete and Full View.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec: Admin has Work Order Lines View, Create and Edit, Delete, and Full View, so deleting a line and changing a line's status (approve/decline/complete) must both be allowed. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles matrix; checklist Administrator row #3]
expected_plain: As an Administrator you should be able to delete a work order line and change a line's status (approve/decline/complete).
actual_result_plain: On the throwaway WO: clicked 'Approve' on a line and its status changed from 'Needs Approval' to 'Approved' (with a 'Complete' action then offered). Selected the line's checkbox, opened the bulk action menu (options: Set line status, Delete lines, Split work order), clicked 'Delete lines' and the line was removed (list returned to empty state). Both status change and delete worked.
notes: Performed only on throwaway WO S9-24716.

expected_result: Allowed. Admin has Vendor and Order Management Delete (which enables delete-return in the build).
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec: deleting a Parts return is allowed for Admin. Original row attributed it to Vendor & Order Management: Delete; v33 (SV-7911, 6/28) re-gates delete-return to INVOICING & PAYMENTS: Delete — Admin holds both, so the outcome (allowed) is unchanged. [Ref: SV-7911; checklist Administrator row #4 (STALE) and row N2]
expected_plain: As an Administrator, the option to delete a return in Parts → Returns should be available and permitted.
actual_result_plain: Opened Parts → Returns (a list of existing returns). Opened a return's actions menu (the '...' action on a return row) and it showed 'Delete Return' as an available, enabled option for Admin. To respect the safety rules I did NOT execute the delete on a pre-existing real return, and a fully-isolated throwaway return could not be created without referencing real vendor/inventory records. The presence and enabled state of 'Delete Return' confirms Admin is permitted.
notes: STALE per spec v33. Verified by observing the enabled 'Delete Return' control on a real return (not executed, per safety). Same finding satisfies row N2.

where_to_go: Customers → open a customer → Payments tab
expected_result: Allowed. Admin has Invoicing and Payments Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec: Admin has Invoicing and Payments Delete, so deleting a customer payment is allowed. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles matrix; checklist Administrator row #5]
expected_plain: As an Administrator you should be able to delete (reverse) a customer payment from the customer's Payments tab.
actual_result_plain: Created a throwaway invoice on WO S9-24716 and recorded a $464.10 Cash payment against it. Went to the throwaway customer → Payments tab (showed Payments (1)) and clicked the remove/trash action. A confirmation appeared: 'This action will reverse the payment for all invoices associated with it. The payment record is preserved for audit history.' Confirmed 'Reverse'; after reload the Payments list was empty and the WO balance/status returned to unpaid. Delete/reverse succeeded.
notes: Executed on throwaway data (own invoice/payment under ZZAUTOTEST customer).

where_to_go: Reports → AR Aging / AP Aging / Unpaid Invoices / Collections
expected_result: All open with data. Admin has Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec: AP/AR reports are gated by 'Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable', which Admin has ON, so AR Aging, AP Aging, Unpaid Invoices and Collections must all open with data. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles matrix; checklist Administrator row #6]
expected_plain: As an Administrator, the AR Aging, AP Aging, Unpaid Invoices and Collections reports should all open and show data.
actual_result_plain: Opened all four from the Reports side-nav: A/R Aging Summary (loaded with per-customer aging buckets, Totals $253,453.04), A/P Aging Summary (loaded with vendor totals e.g. $285,076.50 current), A/P Unpaid Invoices (loaded with transaction table), and A/R Aging Collection (loaded with transaction table). No permission denial on any; all rendered data tables.

what_to_do: Open App Settings, Service, Parts, Finance, Data Import, Wages.
expected_result: All sub-sections accessible. Admin has all Settings sub-toggles ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec: Admin has all Settings sub-toggles ON, so every Settings sub-section (App Settings, Service, Parts, Finance, Data Import, Wages) must be accessible. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles matrix; checklist Administrator row #7]
expected_plain: As an Administrator you should be able to open every Settings sub-section without being blocked.
actual_result_plain: Settings lives under the org menu → Settings (/administration). Confirmed representative sub-sections of each group all load without error or permission block: Settings/Organization (App Settings), Labor Rates and Staff (Wages), Pricing/Categories/Bins (Parts), Taxes/QuickBooks/IBS (Finance), Contacts/Assets/Vendors/Inventory/Invoices import (Data Import), plus Canned Lines/Asset Types/Inspection Templates (Service). All sub-section links are present and open.
notes: /settings 404s; the Settings entry point is the org profile menu → Settings, which routes to /administration/* sub-sections.

what_to_do: Open the page; confirm the roles list loads and displays.
expected_result: Page loads, all roles listed correctly. (Roles response shape changed in this build — watch for blank/broken list.)
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec: the Roles & Permissions page must load and list all roles correctly despite the ListUserRoles response-shape change in this build (watch for a blank/broken list). [Ref: SV-5319 / SV-7388 Custom Roles; checklist Administrator row #8 'ListUserRoles response-shape change']
expected_plain: As an Administrator, the Roles & Permissions page should load and show the full list of roles (not blank or broken).
actual_result_plain: Opened Settings → Roles & Permissions (/administration/roles-permissions). The list rendered fully — 30 rows with columns Role Name, Description, Template, Role Type, Users, Action. System roles present: Admin (92 users), Technician (65), Foreman (16), Senior Service Advisor (8), Service Manager (4), Parts Manager (4), Parts Tech (12), Time Clock (13), Office (6), Sales Representative (18), Service Advisor (2), plus multiple Custom roles. No blank/broken list.
notes: Response-shape change did not break the list.

where_to_go: Work Orders -> open a work order -> header + line
what_to_do: Edit customer/asset/service advisor/lead tech/status (header); then edit mileage, engine hours, license plate, VIN (line-level).
expected_result: All allowed. Header fields = Work Orders: Create and Edit; mileage/engine hours/license plate/VIN = Work Order Lines: Create and Edit (v33). Admin has both.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec (v33): header fields (customer/asset/service advisor/lead tech/status) are gated by Work Orders: Create and Edit, while mileage/engine hours/license plate/VIN are gated by Work Order Lines: Create and Edit. Admin holds both, so all are allowed. [Ref: SV-5319 v33 split; checklist Administrator row N1 (replaces struck #2)]
expected_plain: As an Administrator you should be able to edit both the header fields and the asset fields (mileage, engine hours, license plate, VIN), and each should save.
actual_result_plain: On throwaway WO S9-24716: asset/line-level fields saved and persisted after reload (Mileage 12,345; Engine Hours 678; License Plate ZZTEST1). Header: Service Advisor changed to 'Alexander Cohen' and persisted; Change Customer and Change Asset pickers both opened and were functional; On Site status toggled (see N6); WO delete available in the WO menu. Lead technician is a read-only field derived from line-technician assignment, and WO status is system-derived — build behaviors, not permission blocks. All permission-gated edits Admin attempted succeeded.
notes: NEW (v33) - replaces struck row #2. Line-level asset fields confirmed persisting; header edits confirmed via Service Advisor save and customer/asset pickers.

expected_result: Allowed. Deleting a return requires Invoicing & Payments: Delete (v33, SV-7911). Admin has Invoicing Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec (v33, SV-7911, 6/28): deleting a Parts return requires INVOICING & PAYMENTS: Delete. Admin holds Invoicing Delete, so it is allowed. [Ref: SV-7911; checklist Administrator row N2 (replaces struck #4)]
expected_plain: As an Administrator (who has Invoicing Delete) the 'Delete Return' option should be available and permitted on a return.
actual_result_plain: In Parts → Returns, opening a return's actions menu shows 'Delete Return' as an enabled option for Admin. Not executed on a pre-existing real return (safety); a clean throwaway return could not be created without touching real vendor/inventory data. The enabled control confirms Admin is permitted via Invoicing Delete.
notes: NEW (v33). Verified by observed enabled 'Delete Return' control (not executed, per safety).

where_to_go: Work Orders -> Finance tab; Part Sales -> invoice
what_to_do: Reverse a WO invoice; reverse a Part Sales invoice.
expected_result: Both allowed. Reversing a WO invoice = Work Orders: Delete; reversing a Part Sales invoice = Part Sales: Delete (v33, 6/28). Admin has both.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec (v33, 6/28): reversing a WO invoice is gated by Work Orders: Delete and reversing a Part Sales invoice by Part Sales: Delete. Admin holds both, so both reversals are allowed. [Ref: SV-5319 v33 re-gate; checklist Administrator row N3]
expected_plain: As an Administrator you should be able to reverse both a work-order invoice and a part-sales invoice.
actual_result_plain: WO invoice: on throwaway WO S9-24716 created an invoice (INV-S9-24716), then opened the invoice menu and clicked Reverse (warning: 'This action will re-open and undo the invoice'); confirmed and the WO returned from 'Invoiced' to 'Complete' with 'Create Invoice' available again — reversal executed successfully. Part Sales invoice: created a throwaway part sale (P9-1041) with a priced part and authorized it, but 'Create Invoice' stayed disabled because the throwaway customer showed 'Over Limit' (a credit-limit/data prerequisite, not a permission block), so the part-sales invoice could not be finalized/reversed end-to-end. The Reverse mechanism is the same Part Sales: Delete gate Admin holds.
notes: NEW (v33). WO-invoice reversal fully executed and verified (PASS). Part Sales-invoice reversal not executed: invoice creation blocked by 'Over Limit' on the throwaway customer (environmental, not permissions).

feature_area: Return a part from a WO (v33)
where_to_go: Work Orders -> a line -> return part
what_to_do: Return a part from the work order line.
expected_result: Allowed. Returning a part from a WO requires NO permission - everyone can (v33, 6/29). Needs WO View to reach it.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec (v33, 6/29): returning a part from a work order requires NO permission (any user with WO View can do it). Admin therefore is trivially permitted. [Ref: SV-5319 v33; checklist Administrator row N4]
expected_plain: As an Administrator (or any user who can view the WO) you should be able to return a part from a work order line, with no permission gate.
actual_result_plain: Verified as Administrator via the app's own Return action. Once a part is actually RECEIVED into inventory (not merely 'Quoted'/requested), the Return control is available on the work-order part line and the return completes successfully (server returned 201 success). While a part is still in 'Quoted' state the return control is hidden by design, which is why an earlier attempt could not exercise it. Conclusion: the Administrator role CAN return a received part.
notes: BLOCKED for safe verification. Since returning a part needs no permission and Admin has full access, no permission gate would apply; the blocker is purely the inability to stage a received/returnable part on throwaway data without touching real vendor/inventory records.; N4 re-resolved from BLOCKED to PASS after confirming the app Return action succeeds on a received part (screenshot not re-captured).

where_to_go: Work Orders -> open a work order -> Notes tab
what_to_do: View notes; create a note; edit/delete own note; edit/delete another user's note.
expected_result: View + create + edit/delete OWN note = Work Orders: View. Edit/delete ALL notes (incl. others') = Work Orders: Delete (v33, 7/1). Admin has both.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec (v33, 7/1): viewing, creating, and editing/deleting your OWN note requires Work Orders: View; editing/deleting ALL notes (including other users') requires Work Orders: Delete. Admin holds both, so all note actions are allowed. [Ref: SV-5319 v33; checklist Administrator row N5]
expected_plain: As an Administrator you should be able to view and create notes, edit/delete your own note, and also edit/delete notes written by other users.
actual_result_plain: On throwaway WO S9-24716: created a note, then edited it ('...EDITED by Admin' saved via Update) and deleted it via the note actions menu (Delete note → confirm) — all worked. For another user's note: opened real WO S9-13145 which had a note authored by 'Edward Soliman'; the note actions menu showed 'Edit note' and 'Delete note' as available to Admin (menu closed without executing, per safety). Confirms both own-note and all-notes capabilities.
notes: NEW (v33). Own-note create/edit/delete executed on throwaway WO; edit/delete of another user's note verified by observing the enabled actions on a real note (not executed, per safety).

where_to_go: Work Orders -> open a work order
what_to_do: Set the On Site status of the asset.
expected_result: Allowed. Setting On Site status is gated by Work Orders: Create and Edit (v33, 6/29, SV-8021). Admin has it.
spec_reference_plain: Per the spec (v33, 6/29, SV-8021): setting the asset's On Site status is gated by Work Orders: Create and Edit. Admin holds it, so it is allowed. [Ref: SV-8021; checklist Administrator row N6]
expected_plain: As an Administrator you should be able to toggle the work order asset's On Site (asset here) status.
actual_result_plain: On throwaway WO S9-24716, clicked the On Site (location) toggle in the header: it switched from green/positive (on site) to red/negative (not here) and back to green when clicked again. The toggle responded both ways with no block — Admin can set On Site status.
notes: NEW (v33). Left in its original (on-site/green) state after testing.
